correctness.rationale: With a,b,c,Dx,Dy>0, ab>c^2 and r>=0, SPD drift plus nonexpansive projection gives unique stationary law. Its generator gives (2a+r)u-2cz=2Dx, 2bv-2cz=2Dy, (a+b+r)z=c(u+v); determinant 2Delta>0 for all parameters. Independently solved these equations symbolically and verified u,v,z, J_cont=c(u-v)+(a-b)z=cP/Delta, J_lag=J_cont+rz=2cQ/Delta, where P is the stated concave quadratic and Q stated affine function. Their sign partitions, roots and strict boundary cases follow directly; the explicit positive finite-lag factor follows from 2x2 symmetric semigroup B and eta>0. A new independent SymPy script checks all these symbolic identities as algebra, not just finite numerical samples. The prior October 25 source independently yields identical covariance specialization. Assumptions omit reset jumps from continuous area and do not count winding; no observed correctness defect.
